tasks.title: HAL: AP-capable USB adapter detection + device registry
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/005-usb-wifi-ap/{requirements.md, design.md, acceptance/usb-ap.feature}. SECOND: implement hal/internal/network/ap_detector.go scanning USB WiFi adapters via `iw phy` + `iw list`. (REQ-500/501/502) Mark AP-capable adapters in the HAL device registry; expose via GET /hal/network/wifi-adapters. Test on Pi 5 with at least one mt7612u + onboard wlan0 to verify both surface correctly.

tasks.title: API: AP interface selector + persistence + network-mode-switch saga integration
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/005-usb-wifi-ap/{requirements.md, design.md, acceptance/usb-ap.feature}. SECOND: implement api/internal/handlers/network_ap.go with GET /api/v1/network/ap-interfaces (REQ-503), POST /api/v1/network/ap-interface (REQ-504/505/507), GET /api/v1/network/ap-status (REQ-515). Persist + read at boot (REQ-508).
